part.text:
Done. The fix addresses issue #11735 (v-bind-in-CSS + child component style bindings causing SSR hydration style mismatches):

- `packages/shared/src/escapeHtml.ts`: added `getEscapedCssVarName` (and `cssVarNameEscapeSymbolsRE`) — escapes CSS var name symbols the same way the compiler/SSR do (e.g. `foo.bar` → `foo\.bar`).
- `packages/runtime-core/src/hydration.ts:932-938`: `CssVarsHydrator.resolveCssVars` now inserts css vars into the hydration style expectation map with escaped names (`--foo\.bar`), matching the server-rendered attribute, instead of the raw unescaped key (`--foo.bar`).

Validation: the previously failing `escape css var name` test now passes, all 90 hydration tests + 281 server-renderer/compiler-sfc/runtime-core cssVars tests pass, and `tsc --noEmit` is clean.
